spans.s: तिरश्ची f. The female of any animal other than man.
तिर्यच् (I) a. (f. तिरश्ची; according to some, also तिर्यची) 1. Oblique, transverse, horizontal; 2. crooked, curved.
तिरश्चीन a. (f. ना) 1. Oblique, awry, गतं तिरश्चीनमनूरुसारथेः Sis.i.2; 2. irregular.
तिरश्चीन a. (f. ना) 1. Oblique, awry, गतं तिरश्चीनमनूरुसारथेः Sis.i.2; 2. irregular.

तिरस् ind. A particle meaning- (1) crookedly, obliquely, e.g. तिरो गत्वा समीक्षेत; (2) invisible, unseen [in classics, it is not used by itself but in composition with the roots कृ, M.iv.49, R.iii.8, xvi.20, Am.
), धा (R.x.48), and भू (Bt.xiv.44) qq.vv.].
तिरस्-करिणी, -कारिणी f. 1. a curtain, a veil, तिरस्करिण्यो जलदा भवंति K.S.i.14; 2. an outer tent, a screen of cloth.
तिरस्-करिणी, -कारिणी f. 1. a curtain, a veil, तिरस्करिण्यो जलदा भवंति K.S.i.14; 2. an outer tent, a screen of cloth.
तिरस्-कार m. 1. concealment, disappearance; 2. abuse, reproach; 3. contempt, despise.
तिरस्-क्रिया f. 1. concealment, disappearance; 2. abuse, reproach; 3. contempt, despise.
तिरस्-कृत a. 1. disregarded, abused; 2. condemned; 3. covered.
तिरोधान n. 1. disappearance, removal, अथ खलु तिरोधानमधियाम् G.
; 2. a covering, a veil, a sheath.
तिरोभाव m. disappearance.
तिरोहित a. 1. vanished, disappeared; 2. covered, concealed.
तिरय् vt. (denom. pres. तिरयति) 1. To keep hidden or concealed; 2. to hinder, to obstruct, to stop, वारंवारं तिरयति दृशोरुद्गमं बाष्पपूरः M.M.i.; 3. to conquer.
तिर्यक् ind. Obliquely, crookedly, in a slanting direction, Megh.i.51, K.S.v.74.
तिर्यच् (I) a. (f. तिरश्ची; according to some, also तिर्यची) 1. Oblique, transverse, horizontal; 2. crooked, curved.
तिर्यच् (II) m.n. Any animal other than man (who walks erect, while other animals walk horizontally), लज्जा तिरश्चां यदि चेतसि स्यात् K.S.i.48.
तिर्यगंतर n. intermediate space measured across.
तिर्यगयन n. the annual revolution of the sun.
तिर्यगीक्ष a. looking obliquely.
तिर्यग्जाति f. the brute kind (as op. to man).
तिर्यक्प्रमाण n. breadth.
तिर्यक्प्रेक्षण n. a side-look.
तिर्यग्योनि f. the animal creature (as op. to human race), तिर्यग्योनौ च जायते M.iv.200.
तिर्यच्-स्रोतस् f. the animal world.
तीर (I) n. 1. A shore, a bank, R.xiv.76; 2. margin, brim, edge.
तीर (II) m. 1. A sort of sparrow; 2. lead; 3. tin.
तीरित (I) a. (f. ता) Settled, decided according to evidence.
तीरित (II) n. Completion of any affair.
तीरित (I) a. (f. ता) Settled, decided according to evidence.
तीर्ण a. (f. र्णा) 1. Crossed, passed over; 2. spread; 3. surpassed, excelled, (pp. of तॄ q.v.).
तीर्ण a. (f. र्णा) 1. Crossed, passed over; 2. spread; 3. surpassed, excelled, (pp. of तॄ q.v.).

तीर्थ (I) n. 1. A passage, a road, a ford; 2. a descent into a river, कृततीर्थः पयसामिवाशयः Kir.ii.3 (where the word is used in this sense and in sense 5); 3. a place of water; 4. a holy place, a place of pilgrimage, especially one on or near the banks of a sacred river or spring, R.i.85; 5. a means, an expedient, a remedy, अनेन तीर्थेन घटेत M.M.i.; 6. a preceptor, a teacher, मया सुतीर्थादभिनयविद्या शिक्षिता Mal.i.; 7. source, origin; 8. a sacrifice; 9. a minister; 10. advice, instruction; 11. certain parts of the hand sacred to various deities; 12. an object of veneration, a worthy person, a fit recipient, M.iii.130; 13. a school of philosophy; 14. fire; 15. pudendum, muliebre; 16. menstrual courses of a woman; 17. a Brāhmaṇa.
तीर्थ (II) m. An honorary affix to the names of saints and ascetics.
तीर्थ-उदक n. holy water, तीर्थोदकं च वह्निश्च नान्यतः शुद्धिमर्हतः Ut.i.
तीर्थ-कर m. 1. a sanctified saint of the Jainas; 2. the founder of a new system of philosophy or of a new religious sect; 3. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
तीर्थंकर m. a Jaina Arhat.
तीर्थ-काक, -ध्वांक्ष m. a crow at a sacred bathing-place, i.e. too greedy.
तीर्थ-काक, -ध्वांक्ष m. a crow at a sacred bathing-place, i.e. too greedy.
तीर्थ-यात्रा f. a visit to a sacred place, a pilgrimage.
तीर्थ-राज m. a name of Prayāga.
तीर्थ-राजि, -राजी f. an epithet of Benares.
तीर्थ-राजि, -राजी f. an epithet of Benares.
तीर्थ-वाक m. the hair of the head.
तीर्थ-विधि m. rites observed at a place of pilgrimage.
तीर्थ-सेविन् (I) a. a pilgrim.
तीर्थ-सेविन् (II) m. the Indian crane.
तीर्थिक m. A pilgrim, an ascetic Brāhmaṇa.
